name: DeKalb
schedule: First Tuesday monthly, 9am to 4pm, DeKalb County Courthouse, Decatur
note: Only the upcoming sale list is posted. Prior sales come from the excess funds list (parcels that sold above what was owed).

auction.time: First Tuesday of the month, generally April through December; check-in 9:00 am, sale begins 10:00 am
auction.registration: Registration is required for each sale: submit the online pre-registration form by 2:00 pm on the Monday before the sale. Onsite registration and check-in begin at 9:00 am. Business owners must bring a copy of their articles of incorporation.
auction.payment: Cash, cashier's check or bank wire transfer payable to DeKalb County Tax Commissioner; no personal or business checks, ACH, third party checks, money orders or cards. Funds must be received in hand by 1:30 pm on sale day or the parcel is re-cried at 2:00 pm.
auction.office: DeKalb County Tax Commissioner, Delinquent Collections Division
vital: Caveat emptor (buyer beware) applies to every sale; do your own title research.
Opening bid is the total of taxes and costs; bids are in whole dollars and you must raise your auction paddle and call out the amount.
The buyer gets a tax deed but no immediate control; the owner may redeem within 12 months by paying the bid plus 20% for the first year and 10% for each additional year.
The tax deed is forwarded within 30 working days of the sale.
The tax office may set a sale aside within 30 days and refund the bid (O.C.G.A. 9-13-172.1).
All bids are binding; a bidder who does not pay may be liable for the difference at resale and barred from future sales.
auction.confirmed: September 1, 2026 tax sale flyer and 2026 event calendar; site copyright 2026
